customers.name: Ravi Kumar
profile: Ravi Kumar works from home as a software tester and needs stable internet between 9 AM and 6 PM.
Ravi prefers short, step-by-step instructions and gets irritated by long scripted greetings.
Ravi's router is kept in the hall, far from his work room on the first floor.

tickets.issue: Internet very slow in the evening, speed test showed 12 Mbps on a 100 Mbps plan.
tickets.resolution: Router was on the crowded 2.4 GHz band. Switched his laptop to the 5 GHz network (SwiftNet_5G). Speed went back to 94 Mbps.

tickets.issue: Wi-Fi drops every few minutes in the first-floor room.
tickets.resolution: Signal too weak upstairs. Recommended a mesh extender; Ravi said he would think about it. Temporary fix: moved router higher on a shelf.

tickets.issue: Slow speed again after a power cut.
tickets.resolution: Router had reset to default channel settings after the power cut. Restarted router and reconnected to 5 GHz. Fixed in 5 minutes.

customers.name: Priya Reddy
profile: Priya Reddy runs an online boutique and uploads product videos daily.
Priya prefers to be contacted on WhatsApp, not phone calls.
Priya was promised a loyalty discount in July 2026 that has not been applied yet.

tickets.issue: Upload speed only 20 Mbps, needs faster uploads for videos.
tickets.resolution: Plan is symmetric but ONT firmware was outdated. Pushed firmware update 3.4.1 remotely. Upload went to 280 Mbps.

tickets.issue: Charged twice for the OTT Pack in the July bill (Rs 299 extra).
tickets.resolution: Duplicate charge confirmed and refund raised. Agent also promised a 10% loyalty discount from August. Discount not yet visible in system.

tickets.issue: Asked why loyalty discount is missing from August bill.
tickets.resolution: Escalated to billing team, ticket BIL-5521 still open.

customers.name: Mohammed Irfan
profile: Mohammed Irfan is a competitive online gamer and cares about ping, not just speed.
Irfan is technical and prefers detailed explanations with actual numbers.

tickets.issue: High ping (120 ms) to Mumbai game servers in the evening.
tickets.resolution: Traffic was routing via Chennai. Network team applied a routing fix; ping dropped to 18 ms.

tickets.issue: Ping spikes when family streams 4K video.
tickets.resolution: Enabled QoS on his Netgear router with gaming device priority. Spikes stopped.

customers.name: Lakshmi Devi
profile: Lakshmi Devi is a retired teacher, 67 years old, and is not comfortable with technical terms.
Lakshmi prefers explanations in simple Telugu-English and likes the agent to be patient.
Lakshmi mainly uses internet for video calls with her son in the USA on Sunday mornings.

tickets.issue: Video call with son keeps freezing.
tickets.resolution: Her phone was connected to neighbour's open Wi-Fi by mistake. Reconnected to her own network SwiftNet_Lakshmi and saved password. Calls fine.

tickets.issue: Forgot Wi-Fi password after buying a new phone.
tickets.resolution: Guided her to read password from the sticker under the router. Took 20 minutes, she was grateful for patience.

customers.name: Arjun Varma
profile: Arjun Varma runs a small printing shop and uses internet for billing software and UPI payments.
Arjun has threatened to switch to another provider if outages continue.

tickets.issue: No internet, red LOS light on ONT.
tickets.resolution: Fiber cut on the street due to road work. Technician repaired in 6 hours.

tickets.issue: Red LOS light again, shop billing stopped.
tickets.resolution: Fiber connector loose inside the shop. Technician re-spliced. Offered 3 days service credit.

tickets.issue: Internet down for 2 hours during business time.
tickets.resolution: Area power outage at the local node. Node battery backup was faulty; network team replaced it.

customers.name: Sneha Patnaik
profile: Sneha Patnaik is a college lecturer who takes online classes from home.
Sneha has two kids who use the network heavily after 4 PM.

tickets.issue: Too many devices, laptop disconnects during online class.
tickets.resolution: D-Link router supports limited clients. Set up a separate guest network for kids' devices. Class connection stable.

customers.name: Venkatesh Rao
profile: Venkatesh Rao owns a 12-person accounting firm in Madhapur.
Venkatesh needs a static IP for remote access to his office server.
Venkatesh is formal and expects SLA commitments in writing.

tickets.issue: Remote desktop to office server not working from home.
tickets.resolution: Static IP 103.45.xx.xx was assigned but port 3389 forwarding was missing on the ONT. Configured port forwarding. Advised VPN for security.

tickets.issue: Static IP changed after ONT replacement, remote access broke again.
tickets.resolution: New ONT did not have static IP profile. Re-applied profile and port forwarding. Added note: always re-apply static profile after ONT swap.

customers.name: Fatima Begum
profile: Fatima Begum is a homemaker who uses the internet mainly for YouTube cooking videos and smart TV.
Fatima prefers Hindi or Urdu-friendly simple language.

tickets.issue: Smart TV shows 'no internet' but phone works.
tickets.resolution: TV was set to a fixed old IP address. Changed TV network setting to automatic (DHCP). Worked.

customers.name: Karthik Naidu
profile: Karthik Naidu is a freelance video editor who uploads large files to clients abroad.
Karthik is price sensitive and asked twice about cheaper plans.

tickets.issue: Uploads to Google Drive stop midway.
tickets.resolution: Router firmware bug on TP-Link Archer C6 v3 with large uploads. Updated firmware to latest version. Uploads completed.

tickets.issue: Asked about cheaper plan with same upload speed.
tickets.resolution: Shared Fiber 150 annual plan with 2 months free. He said he will decide by October.

customers.name: Anjali Sharma
profile: Anjali Sharma is a new customer who joined in August 2026.
Anjali is moving to a new flat in Madhurawada in October 2026.

tickets.issue: Installation done but internet not working on day one.
tickets.resolution: Account activation was pending in the system. Activated manually. Working.

tickets.issue: Asked how to shift connection to new flat.
tickets.resolution: Explained shifting process: raise request 7 days before, Rs 500 shifting fee, technician visit. She has not raised the request yet.

customers.name: Suresh Babu
profile: Suresh Babu runs a medical shop and uses the internet for a billing app.
Suresh usually calls early morning before opening the shop at 8 AM.

tickets.issue: Billing app cannot connect, other sites open.
tickets.resolution: Billing app server was blocked by router's parental control setting enabled by mistake. Disabled it.

tickets.issue: Internet slow in the morning.
tickets.resolution: Tenda router overheating in closed cabinet. Advised moving to open area. Speed improved.

customers.name: Divya Menon
profile: Divya Menon is a product manager who works hybrid and has frequent international calls.
Divya dislikes being put on hold and prefers email summaries after support calls.

tickets.issue: OTT Pack apps not activated on TV after 3 days.
tickets.resolution: Activation email went to old email address. Updated email and resent codes.

customers.name: Ramesh Goud
profile: Ramesh Goud is a school principal who manages Wi-Fi for a small private school.
Ramesh wants to block social media sites on students' computers during school hours.

tickets.issue: Wanted to block YouTube and Instagram for student computers.
tickets.resolution: Set up TP-Link access control with a schedule 9 AM to 4 PM for the student device group.

customers.name: Pooja Iyer
profile: Pooja Iyer works night shifts for a US company, from 7 PM to 4 AM IST.
Pooja said technician visits must be scheduled after 1 PM because she sleeps in the morning.

tickets.issue: Connection drops around 2 AM during work.
tickets.resolution: Scheduled maintenance window in her area was 1 AM to 3 AM. Added her to maintenance SMS alerts and suggested mobile hotspot backup.

customers.name: Naveen Chowdary
profile: Naveen Chowdary is a startup founder who works late and prefers chat support over phone.
Naveen has a CCTV system that needs remote viewing from his phone.

tickets.issue: Cannot view CCTV from outside home.
tickets.resolution: Customer is behind CGNAT without a public IP. Offered static IP add-on at Rs 200 per month. Customer said he will think about it.
